row: KBTX News 3 is the Brazos Valley's News Leader. KBTX is the CBS affiliate covering Texas's Brazos Valley, including Bryan/College Station, Texas. With studios based in Bryan, KBTX is home of KBTX News 3, KBTX.com, and the CW8 Aggieland.
